# Super-Claude for SAP (SC4SAP)

> An open-source Claude Code plugin that turns Claude Code into a full-stack SAP development assistant. Across ECC 6.0, S/4HANA On-Premise, and S/4HANA Cloud (Public and Private), it reads, writes, and activates ABAP directly through 150+ MCP tools built on ABAP ADT. MIT licensed.

The site is available in Korean (the root), English (/en/), and Japanese (/ja/).

## Key facts

- Platforms: ECC 6.0, S/4HANA On-Premise, S/4HANA Cloud (Public and Private), with ADT enabled
- 150+ MCP tools, provided by the `abap-mcp-adt-powerup` MCP server
- 25 specialist agents: Core 10, Basis 1, Module 14
- 17 workflow skills, including setup, create-program, analyze-code, and team
- Requirements: Node.js 20.0.0 or newer, and the Claude Code CLI (Max or Pro subscription, or an API key)

## Getting started

sc4sap is not on the official Claude Code plugin marketplace yet. Inside a Claude Code session, add the repository as a custom marketplace and install from it:

```
/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/babamba2/superclaude-for-sap.git
/plugin install sc4sap
```

Then run `/sc4sap:setup` and answer once for SAP version, industry, and country. The setup wizard installs the MCP server and registers the permission hooks. `/sc4sap:team` splits work such as reverse engineering, code review, and program generation across the agents.

## Capabilities

1. Auto MCP Install (`/sc4sap:setup`): one-click install of the MCP server, permission hooks, and blocklist hooks
2. Specialist Agents: Core 10, BC 1, and Modules 14, collaborating in parallel through `/sc4sap:team`
3. Program Analyze (`/sc4sap:program-to-spec`): reverse-engineers programs into functional and technical specs
4. Analyze Code: static review for Clean ABAP, performance, and security, with fix suggestions ranked by severity
5. Compare Programs: compares 2 to 5 programs across 10 dimensions and detects clones and divergences
6. Maintenance Diagnosis: first-pass analysis of ST22, SM02, Gateway logs, and the profiler, inside Claude
7. Fit to System: documentation, incident response, and data protection in a single package
8. Reusability and CBO Reuse (`/sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj`): reuses existing Z programs so they never get rebuilt from scratch
9. Industry Context: 14 industry references, including Retail, Auto, Pharma, Banking, Steel, and Utilities
10. Country / Localization: localization for 16 countries, covering e-invoicing, banking, tax, and statutory reporting
11. Active-Module Awareness: recognizes which modules are active together, for example MM+PS for WBS and SD+CO for CO-PA
12. Formatted Auto Program Maker: generates complete programs with Main and Include, ALV, Dynpro, GUI Status, Text Elements, and ABAP Unit
